description: Closes the 11 approved signs questions that carried no objective_code — the 'no orphaned weak-area topics' Stage 1 gate (K53-32). A learner who gets one of these wrong currently lands nowhere. The fix is NOT new sign artwork: weak-area-cards.ts resolves an objective by PREFIX (RR* -> rules lesson, VC* -> controls, otherwise a sign row), so a signs-topic question can point at a rules lesson and it resolves correctly. Two of the eleven already had a home (RR7). The other nine are hosted by three new teaching objects added to src/content/road-rules.ts in the same change — RR27 shape-and-colour, RR28 railway level crossings, RR29 guidance and information signs — plus RR3 for the broken-line item. Ingesting artwork for the GD/GF/GFS families and IN1-IN3 remains open, but the gate does not depend on it.

ops.why: Flashing red signal. Not an orphan at all — a mis-mapping. RR7 'Reading the robot' already exists and is exactly the lesson a learner needs. A traffic signal is not a road sign, so it was never going to resolve against road_signs.
Steady amber. Same as RS-010 — RR7 covers the amber rule directly ('On amber, stop if you can do so safely; do not speed up to beat the light').
Shape and border of a permanent warning sign. A class-level question: no individual sign row can host it, which is why it had no objective. RR27 teaches the shape-per-class discriminator.
Shape of an information sign. Same class-level problem, same host.

Yellow background at roadworks = temporary and overriding. Rests on reg 286A(1)(b)(iii), 'a white, blue or green background becomes yellow retro-reflective' — checked against the regulation, not the question's own explanation.

Controlled level crossing — boom down, red lights flashing. Previously null ON PURPOSE: the library's W318 is the UNCONTROLLED crossing, and pointing here would have taught the wrong hazard. RR28 covers both forms and names the difference.
Green direction sign. The GD family has zero rows in road_signs, so there was nothing to point at. RR29 teaches the guidance classes by colour without needing the artwork.
Brown tourism background. Same missing family (GF), same host.
The 'H' hospital service symbol. Same missing family, same host.
Freeway exit countdown markers — IN1-IN3, which the library does not hold (it holds IN4-IN20). RR29 carries the 300/200/100 m meaning.

Broken white centre line — what it permits. The library has no RM3/WM3 dividing-line row, but the question is really about when you may overtake, and RR3 'No overtaking on a solid line' is its exact counterpart: the broken line is the case where crossing IS allowed. Adding the dividing-line marking is still worth doing; this stops the orphan without waiting for it.
